doc.name: Clear Tape
doc.instructions: Clear Tape's free trading-education tools. The calculate_* tools run the same formulas as the calculators on cleartape.ai and return exact results with units; get_trading_system_rules gives the written rules of 11 preset trading systems; lookup_glossary_term and search_learning find definitions and lessons (English or Chinese: lang "zh"). There is no market data (no prices, quotes, charts or signals). Quote numbers from the results rather than estimating them, link the page each result names, and present results as education, not investment advice.

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.title: Position size calculator
tools.description: Position size from the stop: how many shares to buy (or short) so that a stop-out loses a set percentage of the account. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free position size calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

riskPct.description: Risk per trade, percent of the account (1 = 1%). Above 0, at most 100.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

stop.description: Stop price per share in USD. Below the entry for a long, above it for a short; not equal to the entry.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_risk_reward
tools.title: Risk/reward and R-multiple calculator
tools.description: Risk/reward ratio of a planned trade, the win rate it needs to break even, and (optionally) an exit expressed as an R multiple. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free risk/reward and r-multiple calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

stop.description: Stop price per share in USD; not equal to the entry.

target.description: Target price per share in USD, on the other side of the entry from the stop.

exit.description: Optional: an actual or planned exit price in USD, returned as an R multiple.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_expectancy
tools.title: Trading expectancy calculator
tools.description: Expectancy per trade, per 100 trades, payoff ratio, break-even win rate and profit factor from a win rate and average win and loss. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free trading expectancy calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent (40 = 40%). Above 0, at most 100.

avgWin.description: Average winning trade as a positive amount, in USD or in R.

avgLoss.description: Average losing trade as a positive amount, in the same unit as avgWin.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_atr_stop
tools.title: ATR stop-loss calculator
tools.description: A volatility (ATR) stop: entry minus (long) or plus (short) a multiple of the average true range. Give atr, or at least five recent daily ranges (high minus low). Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free atr stop-loss calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

atr.description: Average true range in USD (e.g. the 14-day ATR). Give this or ranges.

ranges.description: Alternative to atr: 5 to 500 recent daily ranges (high minus low) in USD; their average stands in for the ATR.

multiple.description: ATR multiple for the stop distance, commonly 1.5 to 3.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_drawdown_recovery
tools.title: Drawdown recovery calculator
tools.description: The gain needed to recover from a drawdown and, optionally, how many losing trades in a row at a fixed risk per trade cause it. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free drawdown recovery calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

loss.description: Drawdown in percent of the account (20 = 20%). Above 0, below 100.

riskPct.description: Optional: risk per trade in percent of the account. Above 0, below 100.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_kelly_criterion
tools.title: Kelly criterion calculator
tools.description: Full and fractional Kelly risk per trade from a win rate and payoff ratio, with the edge per 1R and the break-even win rate. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free kelly criterion calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent. Above 0, below 100.

payoff.description: Payoff ratio: average win divided by average loss (2 = winners twice the size of losers).

fraction.description: Share of full Kelly to use, in percent: 25 = quarter Kelly, 50 = half, 100 = full. Above 0, at most 100.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_trading_cost
tools.title: Trading cost calculator
tools.description: The cost of one round trip (commissions, bid-ask spread, slippage) in USD, in R, as a share of the target move and of the position, and over a year of trades. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free trading cost calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

stop.description: Stop price per share in USD; not equal to the entry.

target.description: Optional: target price per share in USD, on the other side of the entry from the stop.

commission.description: Commission per order (each side) in USD; 0 if none.

spread.description: Bid-ask spread per share in USD (paid once per round trip, half on each side).

slippage.description: Slippage per share per side in USD.

trades.description: Optional: round trips per year, for the annual cost.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: calculate_losing_streak
tools.title: Losing streak calculator
tools.description: The exact probability of at least one losing streak of a given length over a number of independent trades, the expected longest streak and the streak 95% of sequences stay within. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free losing streak calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent. Above 0, at most 100.

trades.description: Number of trades, a whole number from 1 to 2000.

streak.description: Losing streak length to test, a whole number no larger than trades.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: get_trading_system_rules
tools.title: Trading system rules
tools.description: Without id: lists Clear Tape's eleven preset trading systems (trend, breakout, momentum and volume) with their style, holding period and one-line entry, stop and exit. With id: one system's exact written rules (entry, stop, exit, target, parameters, the data it needs, terms, where it differs from the published method), its strengths, weaknesses, who it suits and its sources, worded exactly as on its strategy page. Rules only: no signals, no prices, no performance figures. Educational, not investment advice.

id.description: The system to describe; leave out to list them all.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: lookup_glossary_term
tools.title: Trading glossary
tools.description: Looks up a trading term in Clear Tape's bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) glossary of about 70 terms, such as "R multiple", "ATR", "drawdown" or "止损". Matches names, abbreviations and pinyin, and tolerates misspellings. Returns the definition, the term in the other language, close matches and links.

term.description: The term to look up, in English or Chinese.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: search_learning
tools.title: Search trading lessons
tools.description: Searches Clear Tape's free trading education by keyword: the Learn articles, the Academy lessons, the trading-strategy pages and the calculators, in English or Chinese. Returns titles, one-line summaries and links to read the full page. No market data.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "position sizing" or "均值回归".

limit.description: Most results to return (1 to 20, default 8).

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).
